disclosures.text: A power tool comprising a tool housing
A brushless direct-current (BLDC) motor disposed in the tool housing
The BLDC motor includes a stator with a stator core having an aperture
The stator core aperture extends therethrough
The stator includes a plurality of stator windings
The BLDC motor includes a rotor comprising a cylindrical rotor core
The rotor supports at least one permanent magnet around an outer surface of the stator core
The BLDC motor includes a rotor shaft rotatably coupled to the rotor
A stator mount assembly comprising a stator mount
The stator mount includes an axial member secured to the stator
The stator mount assembly includes an integrated mounting member
The integrated mounting member includes a radial member secured to the stator mount
The integrated mounting member includes a ring gear mount extending from the radial member away from the motor
A ring gear supported by the ring gear mount
A transmission secured to the tool housing
The transmission includes a transmission housing having a generally cylindrical body
The transmission includes a planetary gear set including a carrier and at least one planet gear
The at least one planet gear is rotatably mounted to the carrier
The ring gear meshes with the at least one planet gear

A power tool comprising a tool housing, a BLDC motor with a stator and rotor, a stator mount assembly with an integrated mounting member and ring gear mount, a ring gear, and a transmission with a planetary gear set, where the ring gear mes
The rotor comprises a rear wall proximate a rear end of the stator
The rear wall is mounted on the rotor shaft
The rotor shaft extends through the aperture of the stator to be coupled to the input member of the transmission
The axial member of the stator mount comprises a cylindrical portion
The stator core is securely mounted onto the cylindrical portion
The rotor shaft extends through the cylindrical portion
At least one motor bearing having an inner race mounted on the rotor shaft
The motor bearing has an outer race secured within the cylindrical portion
The stator mount includes at least one radial arm
The radial member of the integrated mounting member is molded around the at least one radial arm
The stator mount includes at least one protrusion
The protrusion is received into a peripheral opening of the integrated mounting member
The protrusion secures the integrated mounting member at least rotationally to the stator mount
A carrier bearing configured to support the carrier relative to the stator mount assembly
The stator mount includes a frontal annular body forming a bearing holder for the carrier bearing
The frontal annular body radially aligns the carrier bearing with the radial member of the integrated mounting member
The ring gear mount is discretely coupled to the transmission housing
The transmission housing overlaps at least the ring gear mount of the integrated mounting member
An O-ring disposed between the integrated mounting member and the transmission housing
The O-ring substantially seals the transmission
A nosecone mounted on the tool housing to provide an output member
The output member is configured to be rotatably driven by a cam shaft coupled to the carrier
The transmission housing is integrally formed with the nosecone
The transmission housing extends rearwardly from the nosecone inside the tool housing
A distance between a front end of the motor and a rear end of the transmission is at most 7.7 mm
The motor has an outer diameter smaller than or equal to approximately 52 mm
The motor produces a maximum power output of at least 620 watts from a 20 V max power tool battery pack
The integrated mounting member includes a transmission housing having a generally cylindrical body
The transmission housing integrally extends from the radial member away from the motor
The transmission housing is secured to the tool housing
The transmission housing houses components of a transmission
The components of the transmission include a carrier, at least one planet gear, and a ring gear
The ring gear is supported by the transmission housing
A front portion of the transmission housing extends out of the tool housing
The front portion of the transmission housing is received within the nosecone
An O-ring disposed between the front portion of the transmission housing and the nosecone
The O-ring substantially seals the transmission assembly
The transmission housing includes at least one inner rim that engages an axial end of the ring gear
The inner rim secures the ring gear within the transmission housing
The transmission housing has a plurality of outer protrusions on its outer surface
The outer protrusions are configured to engage a portion of the tool housing to rotationally fix the transmission
